item.title: Murmurly 2.4.0
item.description:
A new look

The window is a Mac window now: a sidebar down the left with Transcripts, Words and Settings, and the page beside it. Transcripts are larger and easier to read, each one shows the icon of the app it went to, and Copy, Polish and Delete appear when you point at it. A strip at the top shows today's words, your streak and the time you've saved, and opens Insights.

The bottom of the sidebar says how Murmurly is set up — your shortcut, which microphone it will use, where cleanup runs — and anything that needs you, like permission to type at your cursor or an update that's ready. Those used to be banners across the top of the page.

Murmurly in the menu bar

Click the menu-bar icon for your last dictation (one click copies it back) and quick switches for the microphone, cleanup and language. Right-click for the full menu as before.

Words

The dictionary and snippets now share one page, as two tabs with one search.

Settings, sorted

Settings is one window with five sections — Dictation, Cleanup & AI, General, Privacy & Data and Account — instead of two long tabs. Privacy & Data says plainly what leaves your Mac, worked out from your own settings. Your cleanup instructions now have a Save button, so a half-typed instruction is never used.

The capsule

The recording capsule is always dark, so it reads the same over any app. It shows a lock when you're recording hands-free and says when your words are still being cleaned up.

First run, one step at a time

Setup asks for one thing at a time and ends with you saying a sentence, so you know Murmurly can hear you before you start.

Fixes

  • Snippets reach your cursor exactly as you wrote them.
  • A deleted transcript, dictionary entry or snippet can be brought back with Undo.
  • The shortcut recorder won't accept a chord that would break copy, paste or

    • other everyday keys.

  • Cleanup is better at catching a reply where your words should have been.
  • Your history and counts survive a damaged file instead of starting over.
  • Being signed out after a while away no longer happens when a quiet refresh

    • would do.

  • The update status can no longer get stuck on "Checking…".
